item.title: Agentflow is now 10xGraph
item.description: Agentflow is now 10xGraph. Why we renamed it, what the framework is, what stays the same in your code, what changes in package names, and the honest gaps.

item.title: Your agent charged the card twice: making tool calls replay-safe
item.description: Why a crash mid-node re-runs tools that already fired, why the usual fixes fall short, and how 10xGraph's tool ledger and versioned writes close the gap.
item.author: Shudipto Trafder

item.title: Hot and cold agent memory: why 10xGraph puts Redis in front of Postgres
item.description: How PgCheckpointer splits agent state between a Redis hot cache and versioned Postgres history, keeps them consistent, and behaves when either one fails.
item.author: Shudipto Trafder
